name: Quest log: each quest's level, reward XP and scaled mark reach the client
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1. The Ascension client's Extensions.dll answers GetQuestLogTitle's level and the quest log's reward XP for a quest in the log from the player's SMSG_UPDATE_OBJECT_ADDON (0x0578) table, field 61 + quest log slot for the level and field 36 + slot for the XP, instead of the quest cache. Without them the log shows every quest as level 0 in grey. Its GetQuestScaling reads quest flag 0x01000000 from the quest query response and then draws the title in the fixed standard colour; the server sets it only for a quest lifted to the player's level. Quest 7 (Kobold Camp Cleanup) is authored at level 2. With open-world scaling on, a level 30 character plays it at level 30 and the slot must carry 30 and a positive XP reward; with scaling off it carries the authored level 2; a level up re-sends the scaled level. Client rendering is not tested.

steps.label: The server plays the quest at the character's level
Accepting the quest sends its scaled level to its slot
Accepting the quest sends a positive reward XP to its slot
The lifted quest is marked as scaled for the client
Without scaling the server uses the authored level
Turning scaling off sends the authored level
Turning scaling off removes the scaled mark
Turning scaling on sends the scaled level again
Turning scaling on marks the quest as scaled again
A level up sends the new scaled level
